An attitude like the flowers that break through the asphalt and sprout from its cracks; pure ‘kintsugi’, the problem turned springboard.”

strings.“La femme fatal es una construcción masc: “The femme fatale is a male, cinematic construct, but one that often ends up exploding into female liberation. Because of the three archetypes with which patriarchy has shaped woman, mother/wife/whore, the one that throws traditional masculinity off balance, the one that brings down even the most solid of studs, is the third; hence the slap dealt to Gilda.” (Pedro A. Curto). Portrait of Marian Puertas, using the body and headdress of Carmen Miranda, made in black and white with a touch of colour in mixed media. The aim of this work was to give material form to a personal vision of Bilbao and so contribute to the “Postalak” project. To do so, as is usual with me, I focused on the human side. I developed this composition using more mixed techniques than ever. In creating this piece, I drew on analogue illustration and collage as well as digital collage and retouching: I made the physical drawing with Faber-Castell Art & Graphic coloured pencils on white 80 g/m² paper, dimensions 20×10 cm. In drawing it, I adapted the silhouette of Carmen de Miranda to that of Marian Puertas. The tangible collage is made up of another collage — built from a box of chocolate sardines, the wrapper of one of those pieces and blue cellophane — plus a shell, adhesive putty, rhinestones, yellow netting, little bits of another, blue netting, masking tape, double-sided adhesive tape, gold metallic plastic, petals and a kind of lichen or dried seaweed. All on light blue 80 g/m² paper, size 23×18 cm. I scanned both pieces and, now in digital format, laid the figure of the protagonist over the earlier design. Finally, I made a few variations digitally, also adding a small collage of 3 gilda pintxos to the headdress on her head, which refer not only to Bilbao and Carmen Miranda, but also to Rita Hayworth and Marian Puertas.

strings.Retrato 3D realizado a partir de una ima: 3D portrait made from an image of a video still — with scenery from the children’s song “Babyshark” — printed several times on photographic paper. I made the frame that embraces the work from a tin, which was intervened as follows: First, I created a ring of thick wire at the bottom of the piece to act as its stand. After that, I fitted the background into the tin and went on mounting multiple parts of the photograph in different layers, using a hot glue gun to build an image with relief and depth. At the top I added, with hot glue, a crown made from different kinds of shells with acrylic paint, wire, half a roll of sticky tape, gold enamel, silver mica and clear enamel with gold glitter. In the same way I decorated the inside of the portrait with silver mica, clear enamel with gold glitter and small sea-snail shells with acrylic paint. On the back, I created a small composition with greetings stickers, decorated tissue paper, blue cellophane, silver mica, a piece of seaweed cut out of a photograph and a mini-lighthouse (a cocktail stick with a decorative detail, a piece of drinking straw, an earphone cover, gold plastic-coated wires, acrylic paint and gold glitter). I worked in the name of the work and my signature with tape from an old Dymo label maker.

strings.“El amor es el más viejo, a la vez que e: “Love is the oldest and, at the same time, the newest and only event in the world.” (Friedrich Rückert). Double 3D portrait made from three photographs and worked in several articulated layers which, when moved, tell a small yet great story: that of the love of its protagonists. I made the frame for these images from a tin, intervened as follows: First, I created the inner portrait by mounting small parts with a hot glue gun to build an image with relief and depth. I used a photo published by him as the background. I set the sunglasses, in colour, against the rest of the figures in black and white. I decorated it with small flowers and leaves, washi tape and adhesive crystals forming the initials of their names. Covering this layer, I created a lid with a thick sheet, adhesive aluminium and a ring pull. On it I worked reliefs and stuck two labels from an old Dymo. Outer portrait: on the other side of this lid I placed two photographs of the couple, each on their own, on a silver holographic background. Between them, a thought bubble of shared love, and below, two glitter stars that touch. I created a pair of old-style 3D glasses with thick sheet and coloured cellophane to lay over the images like windows. The colours relate to the photos. I made the hinge with fine string and a gold paper straw. Above it, a crown of pink flowers embraces a blue one. After that, I created golden wings from a plastic plate. On the back I signed with decorated adhesive tape (washi tape) and presented the work on a small easel.

strings.Érase Saban que estaba sosegado y calmad: Once there was Saban, calm and serene, stretched out on the hillside green. Even from the horizon he could be seen, lying back, at his ease, beside the trees, eyes closed, feet bare as you please. That’s him over there, do you see? The one sprawled out, arms raised free, folded and propped behind his lovely head. So much enjoyment has it bred that out of him has spread a light breeze with a Saturday taste and his smile without haste... How well it shows, how grand! The forest tinned, nature canned.

strings.Lasaio, lanaro y cuatro gatas enlatadas: Lasaio, lanaro and four she-cats tinned in a tin on pins. Double 3D portrait made from two photographs: one of yours truly and another of Saioa Etxebarria, way back in younger days. I made the frame for the fusion of these images from a tin, intervened as follows: First, I gave it legs using thick wire. After that, I created the background of the portrait with a collage of both photos and finished the inner edges of the tin with a piece of string. The next step was to go on mounting parts of both photographs in different layers, using a hot glue gun to build an image with relief and depth. Lastly, I added small flowers in paper and EVA foam, as well as green tissue paper for leaves and some felines with a message made of wire and hand-written watercolour paper. On the back I covered with gold enamel the hot glue I used to hold the cats in place, and signed with tape from an old Dymo label maker.

strings.Retrato realizado mediante técnica mixta: Portrait in mixed media in a vintage 44×55 cm frame with lovely damp stains and a mount deliciously worn by time. The background is a mosaic of little pieces of metallic plastic sheet — some of them holographic too — which produce all manner of gleams and flashes of colour. strings.Esta obra es una rara avis que destaca e: This work is a rara avis that stands out among its framed mixed-media companions. It brings together an enormous variety of elements and textures that mesh in a collage brimming with meanings. That is why “Las RosaLías” is a painstaking creation, different from others of the same format, strung together with loving care so that everything speaks. It forms a thousand-piece jigsaw that fits together perfectly, like two souls who love each other and melt into an embrace. Realistic/imaginative portrait of a bond in mixed media, made up of illustrations drawn with Faber-Castell Art & Graphic coloured pencils on polyester paper, then scanned, printed on heavyweight paper (350 g/m²), cut out and stuck onto the whole. In the drawing of the feet, the flip-flop straps are decorated with coin frottage, including the messages “United One” and “Rica Silver”. After printing, I intervened the reproduction of this part with liquid latex and acrylic marker pens on the toenails and the labels of the flip-flops. The flowers, in glossy-effect laminated card, I cut out and stuck to the mount. The background beneath the feet I created with crumpled wrapping paper, and the railing they are resting on is black card with coloured letter stickers. The sky is formed of clear cellophane with clouds, laid over sky-blue card. The landscape is an assemblage of felt pieces in different tones and Canson paper scored to give it texture. The trees are made of artificial leaves and brown kraft paper on the felt. The tree trunks, the shine on the railing and the text “las Rosa Lías” I did with Uni-Posca acrylic marker pens. Presented in a 40×50 cm frame with mount.

strings.Naroa Gutiérrez Gil es artista plástica: Naroa Gutiérrez Gil is a visual artist and portrait artist in Bilbao. She makes portraits in drawing, painting, collage, intervened objects and natural slate; this website catalogues 85 of her works.
strings.Su trayectoria documentada reúne 22 encu: Her documented career brings together 22 gatherings with the public between 2010 and 2026: 11 solo exhibitions, 7 group shows, 2 art markets and 2 Walking Gallery walks through the streets of Bilbao. Today she also paints commissioned portraits from your photos.

strings.«“¿Quién es Naroa?” se pregunta mi image: “‘Who is Naroa?’ my image wonders as it looks me in the eye, bouncing back off the glass. I know I dived into this absorbed by faces, with no instructions, and that I found myself in others… And the rest I have yet to discover.”

strings.¡Mejor todavía! Las fotos de carné y los: Even better! Passport photos and posed wedding shots tend to have had the soul ironed out of them. I’d take a blurry photo where the person is cracking up laughing or glancing sideways a thousand times over a lifeless studio image. If you have several different photos (say, one where the face comes out well and another with the clothes they love), I merge them in the studio to compose their real gaze.

strings.¡Es mi especialidad y lo que más me divi: It’s my speciality and what I enjoy most! My pictures eat memories: scraps of sheet music, sugar sachets, bottle tops, grandma’s lace, train tickets, dried petals or buttons from an old coat. You send it to me or bring it to the studio in Bilbao and I sew it on or work it into the piece as part of the picture’s skin.

First we talk about your idea, choose the support (slate, stitched wood, 3D tin or paper) and the size, and I give you a fixed figure in writing. If it suits you, we agree 50% to get started and the remaining 50% on delivery. Always with a fixed quote in advance.

strings.El ritmo habitual de taller es de 2 a 4: The usual studio pace is 2 to 4 weeks: the layers of acrylic, the textures and the UV-protective varnishes need their own organic drying time so they don’t crack. strings.«Mis queridos espejitos de miradas cándi: “My dear little mirrors of candid gazes and magical reflections. Today I slip in through your pupils to invite you to a group show sketched in the feminine along the path of ‘I see me and I hold me dear’, to sidestep the tangle of fear. At the end of last year I was lucky enough to attend the Self-Portrait Workshop led by Ana Rosa Arroyo Ruiz at the association ‘Mujeres en la Diversidad’, run by migrant women and based in Basauri.”
strings.«El 2026 quiero que sea un año de abrazo: “I want 2026 to be a year of embraces: embracing loved ones, welcoming new friends and reconciling my lights and my shadows, so that magical synergies may emerge from them. This constructive fusion that I long for and cultivate — nothing more than personal reminders of my own awakenings — I have also applied to my works. And so the show I present to you here was born: ‘DiviNos VaiVenes’, a twinning of my two latest dances with the visual arts.”
strings.«Domingueras, domingueros… ¡estamos de e: “Sunday day-trippers, ladies and gents… we’ve got something to celebrate! Next Sunday, 25 May, we’ll once again be celebrating art with a seaside scent and a taste of home, wrapped up snugly this time by the Lataska Craft Azoka in Sopela. As you can see, what I’m telling you is nothing less than a perfect plan: heaps of one-of-a-kind pieces in the company of the people who brought them into the world.”
strings.«Este año Amalur acunó un poco más de la: “This year Amalur rocked spring in her arms a little longer than usual, and so spring chose to linger a while in her lap. And along with the blossoms and the longer days, up comes our urge to head for the coast in search of those little rays of light dressed with sea, which so nicely nourish us, put roses in our cheeks and rock us.”
strings.«Porque no sostengo muchas certezas en e: “Because I don’t hold many certainties in this life, yet I have no doubt whatsoever that wrapping myself in one great embrace among women swathed in their art is something I mustn’t lose out on… and one that also invites me to find myself.”
strings.«Contando estrellas, me salió una docena: “Counting stars, I got to twelve, hugged them with my soul and treasured them on its shelf. Each in her own way adorned the dresser, some spilling across the walls, others bringing light and colour… and filling the nook, too, with poetic, musical and performance art.”
strings.«Porque la galería más movida del planet: “Because the planet’s most footloose gallery is back among us, thirsty for your emotional arsenal, ready to soak up that artistic streak that gives us life and show it to the four winds, once again, with art as our banner.”
strings.«Cinco obras que nacieron con la intenci: “Five works born with the intention of making visible the inner turbulence of the human being through illustrious features so that, taking advantage of the closeness that the knowable affords us — that familiarity and rest, that shelter we gather in and project — we can look that turbulence in the eye and so embrace it, which is nothing other than embracing ourselves.”
strings.«Tres ilustres artivistas y servidora co: “Three illustrious artivists and yours truly will hang some of our works on a wall — twenty-nine metres long. We have named this string of faces ‘ICONOS POP’, our very own visual game with the board stood upright. The result: an exhibition of portraits made using different techniques, yet with one and the same heart.”
strings.«Mientras sacaba a la luz mis entresijos: “As I brought my inner workings out into the light, I found myself quite naturally distilling the antidote to my turbulence and slowing down my inner spin cycle, like a magic potion painstakingly designed for me or a melodious mantra to recite as I moved forward, one little step at a time, hand in hand with it, to the stillness of the eye of the storm. And it worked.”
strings.«La vida es como un muro contra el que a: “Life is like a wall I often run smack into. Sometimes the mere fact of crashing into it sets off my laughter, and I cry laughing. Other times, though, I really do hurt myself and, whichever way I look at it, I can find nothing funny in that pain. So I dry my tears and guard them like gold dust, only to end up exhibiting them as the greatest of treasures.”
strings.«Bajo el nombre de una txiriwelta comple: “Under the name of a full txiriwelta, a handful of us artivists will be gathering before you can say Jack Robinson at the Baserri Antzoki in Derio with the perfect excuse, once again, of celebrating ourselves. With our souls scattered over the walls, windows, columns, plinths, beams and even the stage of this farmhouse, we will make up a Multidisciplinary Group Exhibition that we have christened ‘360°’.”
strings.«Sarean es un espacio de encuentro vecin: “Sarean is a neighbourhood meeting place open to every kind of cultural expression, located in Bilbao’s Plaza del Corazón de María. It is a playful setting, experimental and educational in character, which hosts a sociocultural programme designed through citizen participation.”
strings.«El regalo supremo es el que ya ha sido: “The supreme gift is the one already taken in by feeling and mind, the one that has done its work, healed with all its might, turned pain into something bright… hear me: like King Midas we carry a treasure untold, with art to turn our fears into gold.”
strings.«Pero por qué quedarse en el envoltorio,: “But why stop at the wrapping, when if we scratch the surface just a little: jackpot! We are all multicoloured beings. We really are like that, pure spectra of light with little legs and arms; I assure you we carry the fullest Pantone chart inside us.”
strings.«El Ilustre Colegio de Abogados del Seño: “The Ilustre Colegio de Abogados del Señorío de Vizcaya has opened the doors of its exhibition room to me and I — with no wish to compete with the one at Versailles — have decided to turn it, for a couple of moons, into my very own Hall of Mirrors for you. A mille-feuille of canvases, half a dozen wooden plates and the odd dessert.”
strings.«De vez en cuando, las ciudades cobran v: “Every now and then, cities come to life and celebrate themselves. For a few moments, the metropolis that swallows you up as you snake through it in a hurry from one side to the other seems about to give off a kind of amniotic fluid capable of more than satisfying every whim of your multidimensional being.”
strings.«El pasado 1 de Julio terminé de montar: “This past 1 July I finished hanging my current painting exhibition ‘Espejos del Alma’ at the Torre Salazar in Portugalete. The body, as tower and as world… And the world… a labyrinth of mirrors.”

¿Cuánto cuesta un retrato personalizado por encargo?
Presupuesto cerrado previo por escrito según técnica, soporte y formato (piezas en madera, collage textil, pizarra natural o cajas de memoria). Valoración inicial de la idea sin compromiso.
Plazos de ejecución y tiempos de secado
¿Cuál es el plazo de entrega habitual?
Entre 2 y 4 semanas según complejidad y tiempos de secado de óleos, acrílicos, barnices y fijación mineral. Modalidad prioritaria disponible para aniversarios o fechas señaladas con aviso previo.
Proceso de encargo a partir de fotografías
¿Cómo encargar un retrato personalizado a partir de fotografías?
